verdict.rationale: Anytime Mailbox is a consumer and business SaaS, so a natural-language or AI-assistant interface is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence describes only tap-based app and web-portal actions (scan, forward, shred), with no conversational or natural-language command capability. Probes also found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
